player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''CRingwell''') posted a [[Light]] list on DeckTech in November 1999.
description: First Turn-deploy 8d8 and another driod, insert.  Wait for them to do something then deploy the EPP Squads to stop resistance or deploy the space fleet to hold the air.  Deck has been changed even though it had a 8-2 record at DCon in the Wildcard, Invita

notes: Total 60 as published (header counts match). The post has no Objective and marks no starting cards.
Posted 'R2-M5' (x2) matches no card; dested the Light Hoth droid R5-M2 (Arfive-Emmtoo) (letters transposed).
Posted 'Imperial Barrier' is the Dark Interrupt; dested the Light counterpart Rebel Barrier.

Posted 'Yavin IVThrone Room' dested Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room; 'EPP Obi/Luke/Leia' the Enhanced Premiere Obi-Wan With Lightsaber, Luke With Lightsaber, Leia With Blaster Rifle (unique, x2 each, kept as posted); 'Artoo' the Jabba's Palace Artoo; 'R2-D2' R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo); '8d8' 8D8 (Light, Jabba's Palace); Farm and Swamp the Special Edition generic Light sites; 'What're You Trying To Push On Us' What're You Tryin' To Push On Us?; 'The Planet That Its Furthest From' The Planet That It's Farthest From.
Do, Or Do Not and Wise Advice are the Effects of those names (no Defensive Shields in November 1999).
player_note: The description says: 'Deck has been changed even though it had a 8-2 record at DCon in the Wildcard, Invita' (cut off in the archive); the posted list differs from the one played there.
